messages:
deploy-bot: [deploy] Starting rollout: prompt-proxy v2 -> route 'prompt-v2-experimental' (canary 10%) at 1767775500 :rocket:

samir: kicking off monitoring. I’ll watch canary latency/5xx. ping me if anything spikes.

jess: already seeing errors on canary host c-7: `500` from prompt service, stacktrace shows `KV cache miss` flood.
maggie: saw a few user reports of timeouts from the hosted API (region us-east-1). elevated 95p latency ~1200ms vs baseline ~220ms.

samir: rolling back threads? canary still 10% but errors rising. grabbing logs.

rachel: paging the oncall now. @oncall-bot page:eng-oncall (priority=high, reason="prompt-proxy canary 5xx spike")
oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident created -> ENG-4219 (assigned: liam) :rotating_light:

liam: oncall here, joining. can you paste a minimal repro or logs?
jess: tail from c-7: ````
[2026-02-xxT..] ERROR prompt-proxy: upstream prompt-v2 responded 502
[2026-02-xxT..] WARN kvcache: keyset fetch timeout 500ms
[2026-02-xxT..] ERROR router: retry limit reached, returning 502
````

maggie: interestingly, non-canary traffic that hit the fallback route is fine. looks like v2 has a pacing bug under partial cold K/V warming.

samir: impact assessment: errors ~8% of requests routed to v2; customer-visible errors ~0.6% of overall traffic; major impact to low-latency SLAs for ~1% of sessions.
rachel: recommend emergency flag flip for prompt routing -> `route.prompt_v2.enabled=false` and failback to prompt-v1.

liam: agree. will perform kill-switch now. running safe toggle: 
```
# flip to failback immediately
redwoodctl ff toggle route.prompt_v2.enabled --env prod --value false --reason "canary 5xx spike"
```

liam: executing...

deploy-bot: [ff-change] route.prompt_v2.enabled set to false by liam at 1767775865 (propagating)

jess: monitoring – errors dropping on canary hosts. 502s -> 200s on recent samples. :thumbsup:

samir: confirming propagation: all traffic back on prompt-v1 across us-east-1. latency regressing toward baseline.

maggie: initiating canary evacuation: `redwoodctl canary abort --name prompt-v2-canary`

liam: canary aborted. leaving flag off for now. adding quick mitigations note to incident page.
rachel: notifying support to communicate with any affected customers: "We briefly routed a small percentage of traffic to an experimental prompt endpoint which experienced errors; we've disabled the route and traffic has returned to the stable endpoint."

oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident ENG-4219 acknowledged by liam at 1767775890

liam: starting a short post-rollout triage: collect traces, KV warmup profile, and any diff in kernel latency distribution. assigning owners: samir (traces), jess (logs/alerts tuning), maggie (canary config + warmup), rachel (customer comms).

samir: note for postmortem — mitigation was run at 1767775865; impact window ~1767775520-1767775865. please add any customer IDs if flagged by support.

rachel: will open incident doc -> https://redwood.internal/incidents/ENG-4219 (brief + timeline + screenshots). draft message for support pinned.

jess: suggest adding an automated safety check: if canary 5xx > 1% for 30s auto-toggle-off. filing a follow-up ticket.

liam: thanks all — leaving the thread for the postmortem. we kept a quick kill-switch and mitigated within ~5m. good runbook usage.

maggie: postmortem action items: warmup script, canary throttle cap, ff safety rule. adding to backlog. :memo:
